info.title: DecisionVault Universal API
info.description: Manage DecisionVault matters, questionnaires, documents, and webhooks

post.description: Creates a matter in DecisionVault and returns an invite link.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

context.description: Optional context object with up to five string or integer key-value pairs.

matterName.description: The matter name to create in DecisionVault.

questionnaireId.description: The questionnaire ID to use when pre-creating the matter.

post.description: Creates a webhook subscription in DecisionVault for an event type.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.
